_comment: Textos da interface em inglês: {texto em português (como está no código ou no JSON da tela): tradução}. Português é a língua-fonte. tools/i18n/extract_strings.py lista o que falta. Formatos (%s, %d) ficam iguais e na mesma ordem.
Você começa sem nada. Tudo que existe na: You start with nothing. Everything in the match, you ask for by speaking.
Toque em EXTRAIR (o cubo) pra ligar o mo: Tap EXTRACT (the cube) to turn on extraction mode. Then hold the main button while aiming at a building: the blocks break off and become matter in the orb in your hand. Without matter, nothing is created.
Segure FALAR, diga o que você quer e sol: Hold SPEAK, say what you want and let go. It can be simple or absurd, however you imagine it: “i want a pistol that shoots a pigeon that poops grenades”. No voice? Tap TYPE (at the top).
O jogo entende a frase e monta a criação: The game understands the sentence and builds your creation piece by piece, with the matter from the orb. It really works: the main button uses what is in your hand. When it breaks, the matter goes back to the world.
A VOZ PRECISA DE INTERNET NESTE CELULAR: VOICE NEEDS INTERNET ON THIS PHONE
No Android 11 ou anterior, quem entende: On Android 11 or older, your speech is understood by Google speech recognition, over the internet (the audio of the sentence goes to Google). Without a connection, use TYPE. From Android 12 on, voice works offline.
A sua fala é reconhecida no próprio celu: Your speech is recognized on the phone itself. If the game says the language is missing, download English (United States) in the system voice settings. You can also use TYPE.
Your speech is recognized on your own PC. Hold V to speak; T opens the console to type.
